datasets.publication_date: Catalogue describes the ward map as 2024; resource metadata last updated 2025-11-25
datasets.license: Catalogue reports Public Domain; independent rights/legal verification not completed
datasets.crs: KML longitude/latitude coordinates interpreted as WGS84; no independent CRS/positional-accuracy statement verified
datasets.units: Degrees longitude and latitude
datasets.geographic_coverage: Kochi Municipal Corporation; catalogue describes 74 wards
limitations: Structural review found 74 placemarks, 74 unique ward names in ExtendedData, 83 polygon components, 83 coordinate rings, zero unclosed rings, zero malformed coordinate tuples, and zero coordinates outside legal longitude/latitude ranges. This is structural QA, not complete topology validation.
The official Cochin map page is labelled Draft Notification; final notification alignment has not been established.
Do not promote this candidate to the production boundary or use it for exposure analysis until the final official source, topology, legal status, and full geometry comparison are reviewed.

CI acquisition retrieved a 533,483-byte KML with SHA-256 e6376e6a2ac3a0ab28615cd77f4d649bfba5c48034d26c2e31ae295697d06238. Structural checks: 74 placemarks, 74 unique ward names in ExtendedData, 83 polygon components, 83 rings, zero unclosed rings, zero malformed coordinate tuples, and zero out-of-range coordinates.

A full projected geometry comparison (EPSG:32643) found both geometries valid and the ward union valid, but substantial disagreement: candidate ward union 79.0992 km², configured provisional boundary 96.1376 km², intersection 77.3049 km², symmetric difference 20.6271 km², intersection-over-union 0.78937324, and symmetric-difference fraction 0.21062676. This is not a minor boundary discrepancy; do not replace either geometry or use the candidate for exposure masking until source identity and final official notification alignment are resolved.

Candidate bounds [76.2370672, 9.8930813, 76.3399039, 10.0502655] differ from the configured boundary bounds [76.2373589, 9.8897183, 76.3400293, 10.0497693]; the approximate edge differences are 32 m west, 374 m south, 14 m east, and 55 m north. Extent differences are supplementary to the full geometry mismatch.
The official Cochin map page is labelled Draft Notification; final legal boundary alignment and source-specific positional accuracy are not established.

Do not promote this candidate to the production boundary or use it for exposure analysis until the geometry discrepancy, source identity, final official notification, and applicable reuse terms are resolved.
datasets.validation_status: STRUCTURE VALID; SUBSTANTIAL GEOMETRY DISAGREEMENT; NOT APPROVED
datasets.boundary_comparison: Bounding-box only; not approved for boundary replacement.

datasets.license: No dataset-specific reuse terms confirmed; retain official attribution and review reuse terms before redistribution.

datasets.units: One-page cartographic map; not a spatial feature dataset.

datasets.validation_status: OFFICIAL FINAL MAP PDF FETCHED; NOT GIS GEOMETRY; WARD LABEL CROSS-CHECK HAS DISCREPANCIES
limitations: The official KSMART final map PDF was fetched successfully and had a valid PDF signature; its text identifies the date as 27-11-2025.

Automated PDF text extraction found 75 numbered ward labels; 65 labels exactly matched the current SEC register names by ward number, 10 extracted labels differed, and one ward label was not extracted. These are audit flags, not proof of legal identity mismatch; inspect the source PDF and authoritative registers before resolving them.
The final PDF is a visual/cartographic reference and was not converted into GIS polygons. It must not be used as a substitute for validated ward-boundary geometry or as a flood-exposure mask.

The KSMART front-end references vector-tile endpoints on kmapdev.ksmart.live, but read-only requests from the audit environment returned HTTP 403. No access restriction was bypassed; no tile geometry was ingested.
Source layer licensing, georeferencing, positional accuracy, and a GIS export matching the final notification remain unverified.

comparison.configured_boundary_source: data/reference/kochi_corporation_boundary.geojson (provisional DataMeet copy of Kerala OpenSDI layer)

limitations: The public ArcGIS layer returns 76 valid polygons with unique names and codes 1–76, no pairwise interior overlaps over 1 m², and a valid ward union. These are structural/topological checks, not proof of legal boundary currency.

By numeric source code, 65 of 76 names match the current SEC register exactly; 11 code/name pairs differ. The source labels match 75 of the 76 numbered labels extractable from the final-notification PDF; ward 62's label was not extracted from the PDF text.

The union differs from the configured provisional corporation boundary by 6.4018 km² (IoU 0.936091). The configured boundary has no verified publication date or legal currency, so this is a discrepancy to resolve—not proof that either source is correct.

The Esri candidate and the older KSMART-linked draft candidate differ: mean per-ward IoU across 73 valid common polygons is 0.93165904. The older draft has three invalid polygons; invalid source geometry was excluded, not silently repaired.
The service's source item metadata endpoint returned HTTP 404 and the layer's copyright text is blank. Reuse terms, source lineage, publication date, and final Gazette alignment remain unverified.
Raw candidate geometry is not saved or integrated by this audit; it must not be used as a production ward layer or flood-exposure mask.
